title: A+ Core 1 Full Practice Exam A (90 questions)
exam_focus: CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201): mobile devices, networking, hardware, virtualization/cloud, hardware & network troubleshooting
notes: Answer-free copy for test taker. Homemade original; not official CompTIA items.

questions.stem: Which cloud service lets users reach a full hosted desktop environment from a thin client?
Which synchronization method most commonly keeps contacts, calendar, and email on a corporate smartphone in sync with Exchange?
Which protocol uses TCP 445 for Windows file and printer sharing?
A developer wants to deploy code without managing servers or the OS while the provider handles runtime scaling. Which model fits best?
Which device provides power and data to a VoIP phone or wireless AP over one Ethernet cable?
A PC gives a series of beeps and doesn't POST. What should the technician check?

choices.C: The motherboard manufacturer's POST beep code documentation

questions.stem: Which cooling component spreads heat from the CPU to the heatsink and should be reapplied when the cooler is removed?
A user's display shows dead pixels in fixed spots. Which statement is correct?

choices.A: Updating the GPU driver will fix it
choices.B: It's a panel hardware defect, usually fixed by replacing the panel
choices.D: It means the cable is unplugged

questions.stem: Which fiber type is generally used for the longest distances?
A user's printouts come out as garbled characters and random symbols. What is the most likely cause?
Which network type connects devices in a single building or campus?
Which laser printer step uses heat and pressure to bond toner to the paper?
Paper jams happen often and several sheets feed at once. What should be checked first?

choices.A: Pickup rollers / separation pad and the paper type

questions.stem: Which wireless band generally gives the longest range and best wall penetration?
Which accessory lets a laptop user add more ports, external monitors, and wired Ethernet through a single connection?
A system's clock keeps resetting to the default date after being unplugged. What is the most likely fix?
A server's RAID controller shows a battery-backed cache (BBU) failure warning. What is the risk?

choices.A: Write caching may be disabled or data may be lost on power failure

questions.stem: A SOHO user wants to reach an internal web server from the internet. Which router setting is required?
Which cloud characteristic lets resources scale up or down automatically with demand?
Which DNS record is used to help receivers check that a sender's domain authorizes a mail server (anti-spoofing)?
A new device can't get an IP address, though others on the same switch can. The DHCP pool is full. What is the best fix?

choices.B: Expand the DHCP scope or shorten lease times

questions.stem: A user wants to replace a laptop's internal storage with the fastest option the motherboard supports. The board has an M.2 slot keyed M that supports PCIe x4. Which drive is the best choice?
Which printer type uses heat-sensitive paper and is common for receipts?
A user's network connection keeps dropping, and the switch port shows many CRC errors. What is the most likely cause?

choices.D: A damaged cable or bad connector

questions.stem: A workstation can reach other local PCs but not the internet. Its IP is correct. What should be checked next?
A user's external monitor flickers. What is the best first troubleshooting step?

choices.C: Check/reseat the video cable and refresh rate

questions.stem: Users near the break-room microwave lose Wi-Fi at lunch. What is the best fix?

choices.A: Move clients/AP to 5 GHz or change the 2.4 GHz channel

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of a virtual machine sandbox?

choices.A: Run untrusted software isolated from the host

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of a motherboard's CMOS battery?

choices.A: Keep the real-time clock and BIOS/UEFI settings while unplugged

questions.stem: Which mobile device feature uses a short-range radio to make tap-to-pay purchases?
Which PSU feature lets the unit run on both 115 V and 230 V AC?
A PC can ping 8.8.8.8 but can't open websites by name. What is the most likely issue?
Which biometric method is commonly used to unlock modern smartphones?
A user pairs a Bluetooth headset, but it won't connect. Which step usually comes first in Bluetooth pairing?

choices.A: Put the device in discoverable/pairing mode
choices.C: Assign a static IP to the headset

questions.stem: What is the main benefit of dual-channel memory?

choices.D: More memory bandwidth from using matched modules in paired slots

questions.stem: Which device forwards traffic between different IP networks using routing tables?
What is the main advantage of ECC RAM in a server?

choices.B: It detects and corrects single-bit memory errors
choices.C: It runs at higher clock speeds than non-ECC

questions.stem: Which internet connection type uses dishes and can have high latency because of distance to orbit?
Which motherboard form factor is the smallest of these?
A user's PC shows a S.M.A.R.T. warning at boot, and file copies are slow. What should the technician do first?
A laser printer repeats the same defect at regular intervals down the page. What is the likely cause?

choices.B: A roller or drum with a defect at that circumference

questions.stem: Which motherboard chip securely stores keys and boot integrity measurements used by BitLocker?
Which tool is best for finding sources of Wi-Fi channel overlap and interference?
A desktop keeps randomly rebooting during games. CPU temps reach 100 °C. What should be done first?

choices.D: Check the CPU cooler seating, fans, and thermal paste

questions.stem: Which port does HTTPS use by default?
A projector image is dim and its fan noise is high after many hours of use. What is the likely cause?
Which DNS record type maps a hostname to an IPv6 address?
Which UEFI feature checks that boot loaders are signed so unauthorized code can't load during startup?
A user's laptop touchscreen shows the image fine but doesn't respond to touch. Which component is most likely faulty?
What is the maximum length of a single Cat 6 copper Ethernet run for standard 1000BASE-T?
Which TCP port is used by RDP?
Which protocol automatically hands out IP addresses, subnet masks, gateways, and DNS servers to clients?
What is the first step of the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology?

choices.D: Establish a theory of probable cause

questions.stem: Which tool attaches RJ45 connectors to twisted-pair cable?
Which cable type is used for cable TV and many cable-modem internet connections?
A user's laptop battery swells and lifts the touchpad. What should the technician do?

choices.B: Store it in a hot car
choices.D: Stop using it, power down, and replace the battery following proper disposal

questions.stem: Which laptop component turns the DC power from the motherboard into the high voltage needed by an older CCFL-backlit LCD?
Which drive interface is common in servers, supports dual-port enterprise drives, and has controllers that can also run SATA drives?
Which hypervisor type runs directly on hardware with no host OS underneath?
Which hardware/firmware setting must usually be on before a Type 2 hypervisor can run 64-bit VMs?
Which command-line tool shows the path and hops packets take to a destination?
Which component in an impact printer strikes an ink ribbon against the paper?
A company wants to push email settings, enforce passcodes, and remotely wipe lost corporate phones. What should it use?

choices.B: A screen-lock app on each phone

questions.stem: What is the subnet mask for a /26 network?
Which type of server stores and shows syslog messages from many network devices?
Which T568B pin order is correct for pins 1 and 2?
Which wireless technology uses a cellular network to give a laptop internet access when no Wi-Fi is available?
Which Wi-Fi security protocol is the current recommendation for SOHO networks?
Which term describes a cloud provider billing customers only for the resources they actually use?
Which display technology has self-emissive pixels, perfect blacks, and no backlight?
Which cloud deployment model mixes on-premises private infrastructure with public cloud services?
A mobile phone won't connect to Wi-Fi but cellular data works. What is a good first step?

choices.D: Toggle Wi-Fi/airplane mode and forget/rejoin the network

questions.stem: A user needs a single port to carry video, data, and power to a modern laptop dock. Which connector is most appropriate?
A computer boots to "No boot device found." The SSD shows up in UEFI. What should be checked next?

choices.D: Boot order / boot mode (UEFI vs. legacy) settings

questions.stem: An inkjet printer's printouts have missing lines and streaks. What is the best first fix?
Which IPv6 address type begins with FE80::?
How are containers different from virtual machines?

choices.B: Containers share the host OS kernel; VMs each run a full guest OS

questions.stem: Which cloud model has infrastructure shared by several organizations with common concerns, such as government agencies?
A company's network gives each department its own broadcast domain on the same physical switches. Which technology does this?
Which address class is 172.16.5.20 part of, and is it public or private?
A laser printer's output smears when touched. Which component is most likely failing?
A laptop has a keyboard key that sticks after a spill. The spill has dried. What is the best course of action?

choices.D: Clean or replace the keyboard per the manufacturer's procedure

questions.stem: A user reports a burning smell and the PC shuts off right after power-on. What is the most likely cause?
A user needs to install a PCIe graphics card that draws 250 W. Besides the slot, what does it most likely need?

choices.A: Supplemental 6/8-pin or 12V-2x6 PCIe power from the PSU

questions.stem: A technician must connect a smartphone's internet connection to a laptop with no Wi-Fi adapter. Which option works?
Which tool traces where a specific cable ends at a patch panel?
Which port does LDAP use for directory queries by default?
Which port and protocol does a mail client use to send email to a server with STARTTLS submission?
Which RAID level stripes data with distributed parity and needs at least three drives?
A RAID 5 array shows a degraded state after one drive failed. What should the technician do?

choices.A: Replace the failed drive and let the array rebuild
choices.B: Add a drive and convert to RAID 0
choices.C: Ignore it; RAID 5 needs no action
